description: This file defines the MetadataHeaderKey interface used for handling metadata header keys in the Ditto project, including parsing, comparison, and path retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: MetadataHeaderKey
classes.description: Interface representing a metadata header key with methods for parsing, comparison, and path management.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a character sequence to create a MetadataHeaderKey instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MetadataHeaderKey from a JsonPointer path.

methods.name: appliesToAllLeaves
methods.description: Indicates if the key applies to all JSON leaves affected by a command.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path associated with this key, adjusted based on whether it applies to all leaves.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the key as it appears in DittoHeaders.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this key with another MetadataHeaderKey based on their paths.
